Scripts.Body:
param([ValidateSet('exploration','confirmation')][string]$Batch = 'exploration')

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = $PSScriptRoot
$runsRoot = Join-Path $root "runs/$Batch"
$pairs = @()
for ($block = 1; $block -le 8; $block++) {
    $baselinePath = Join-Path $runsRoot ('{0:d2}-baseline/run-summary.json' -f $block)
    $candidatePath = Join-Path $runsRoot ('{0:d2}-candidate/run-summary.json' -f $block)
    if (-not (Test-Path $baselinePath) -or -not (Test-Path $candidatePath)) { throw "Block $block is incomplete." }
    $baseline = Get-Content -Raw $baselinePath | ConvertFrom-Json
    $candidate = Get-Content -Raw $candidatePath | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($baseline.Batch -ne $Batch -or $candidate.Batch -ne $Batch -or $baseline.InputSHA256 -ne $candidate.InputSHA256 -or $baseline.InputSHA256 -ne 'DC87DD0FB85CB6F875AC336B70FEFC1E32BB1F284C8F6E011E0CB0256F9A354D') { throw "Batch/input mismatch in block $block." }
    $ratio = [double]$candidate.MeanNs/[double]$baseline.MeanNs
    $pairs += [pscustomobject]@{
        Block=$block
        Order=if ($block % 2 -eq 1) {'baseline-candidate'} else {'candidate-baseline'}
        BaselineMeanNs=[double]$baseline.MeanNs
        CandidateMeanNs=[double]$candidate.MeanNs
        CandidateOverBaseline=$ratio
        LogCandidateOverBaseline=[math]::Log($ratio)
        BaselineAllocatedBytesPerOperation=[double]$baseline.AllocatedBytesPerOperation
        CandidateAllocatedBytesPerOperation=[double]$candidate.AllocatedBytesPerOperation
    }
}

$logRatios = @($pairs | ForEach-Object LogCandidateOverBaseline)
$mean = ($logRatios | Measure-Object -Average).Average
$sumSquares = 0.0
foreach ($value in $logRatios) { $sumSquares += [math]::Pow($value-$mean,2) }
$sd = [math]::Sqrt($sumSquares/($logRatios.Count-1))
$se = $sd/[math]::Sqrt($logRatios.Count)
$critical = 2.364624251
$margin = $critical*$se
$summary = [ordered]@{
    Experiment='string-next-2026-10-19-one-or-more-buffer'
    Batch=$Batch
    Rule='Use a separate confirmation batch only if the exploration 95% paired log-t interval upper bound is below 1; candidate adoption requires the same condition in confirmation.'
    PairCount=$pairs.Count
    DegreesOfFreedom=$pairs.Count-1
    TCritical95Df7=$critical
    PairedLogRatioMean=$mean
    PairedLogRatioSampleStandardDeviation=$sd
    PairedLogRatioStandardError=$se
    PairedGeometricMeanRatio=[math]::Exp($mean)
    Confidence95=[ordered]@{Lower=[math]::Exp($mean-$margin);Upper=[math]::Exp($mean+$margin)}
    BaselineMeanMs=(($pairs.BaselineMeanNs | Measure-Object -Average).Average/1e6)
    CandidateMeanMs=(($pairs.CandidateMeanNs | Measure-Object -Average).Average/1e6)
    Pairs=$pairs
    InputBytes=4172062
    InputSHA256='DC87DD0FB85CB6F875AC336B70FEFC1E32BB1F284C8F6E011E0CB0256F9A354D'
}
$path = Join-Path $root "$Batch-summary.json"
$summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $path -Encoding utf8
Write-Output ('{0}: geometric mean ratio {1:F5}; 95% paired log-t interval [{2:F5}, {3:F5}].' -f $Batch,$summary.PairedGeometricMeanRatio,$summary.Confidence95.Lower,$summary.Confidence95.Upper)

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $baselinePath) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidatePath)) { throw "Block $block is incomplete." }
    $baseline = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $baselinePath | ConvertFrom-Json
    $candidate = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $candidatePath | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($baseline.Batch -ne $Batch -or $candidate.Batch -ne $Batch -or $baseline.InputSHA256 -ne $candidate.InputSHA256 -or $baseline.InputSHA256 -ne 'DC87DD0FB85CB6F875AC336B70FEFC1E32BB1F284C8F6E011E0CB0256F9A354D') { throw "Batch/input mismatch in block $block." }
    $pairs += [pscustomobject]@{
        Block=$block; Order=if ($block % 2 -eq 1) { 'baseline-candidate' } else { 'candidate-baseline' }
        BaselineMeanNs=[double]$baseline.MeanNs; CandidateMeanNs=[double]$candidate.MeanNs
        CandidateOverBaseline=[double]$candidate.MeanNs/[double]$baseline.MeanNs
        LogCandidateOverBaseline=[math]::Log([double]$candidate.MeanNs/[double]$baseline.MeanNs)
        BaselineAllocatedBytesPerOperation=[double]$baseline.AllocatedBytesPerOperation; CandidateAllocatedBytesPerOperation=[double]$candidate.AllocatedBytesPerOperation
        BaselineAssemblySHA256=$baseline.AssemblySHA256; CandidateAssemblySHA256=$candidate.AssemblySHA256
    }
}

$logRatios = @($pairs | ForEach-Object { $_.LogCandidateOverBaseline })
$meanLogRatio = ($logRatios | Measure-Object -Average).Average
$sumSquares = 0.0
foreach ($logRatio in $logRatios) { $sumSquares += [math]::Pow(($logRatio - $meanLogRatio),2) }
$sampleSdLogRatio = [math]::Sqrt($sumSquares / ($logRatios.Count - 1))
$standardErrorLogRatio = $sampleSdLogRatio / [math]::Sqrt($logRatios.Count)
$tCriticalDf7 = 2.364624251
$marginLogRatio = $tCriticalDf7 * $standardErrorLogRatio
$geometricMeanRatio = [math]::Exp($meanLogRatio)
$interval = @([math]::Exp($meanLogRatio - $marginLogRatio),[math]::Exp($meanLogRatio + $marginLogRatio))
$summary = [ordered]@{
    Experiment='string-cursor-bounds-2026-10-18'; Batch=$Batch;
    Rule='Candidate adopted only when the geometric mean of paired candidate/baseline ratios has a 95% Student t interval upper bound below 1; interval is calculated on log ratios and exponentiated.'
    PairCount=$pairs.Count; DegreesOfFreedom=$pairs.Count-1; TCritical95Df7=$tCriticalDf7
    PairedLogRatioMean=$meanLogRatio; PairedLogRatioSampleStandardDeviation=$sampleSdLogRatio; PairedLogRatioStandardError=$standardErrorLogRatio
    PairedGeometricMeanRatio=$geometricMeanRatio
    Confidence95=[ordered]@{Lower=$interval[0];Upper=$interval[1]};
    BaselineMeanMs=($pairs.BaselineMeanNs | Measure-Object -Average).Average/1e6
    CandidateMeanMs=($pairs.CandidateMeanNs | Measure-Object -Average).Average/1e6
    Pairs=$pairs
    BaselineLaunches=@(1..8 | ForEach-Object { Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runsRoot ('{0:d2}-baseline/run-summary.json' -f $_)) | ConvertFrom-Json })
    CandidateLaunches=@(1..8 | ForEach-Object { Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runsRoot ('{0:d2}-candidate/run-summary.json' -f $_)) | ConvertFrom-Json })
    InputBytes=4172062; InputSHA256='DC87DD0FB85CB6F875AC336B70FEFC1E32BB1F284C8F6E011E0CB0256F9A354D'
}
$summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root "$Batch-summary.json") -Encoding utf8
Write-Output ('Paired candidate/baseline geometric mean ratio {0:F5}; 95% t interval [{1:F5}, {2:F5}] (log scale, df=7).' -f $geometricMeanRatio,$interval[0],$interval[1])
